concept.description: Labels every class annotated with @RestController or @Controller with :Controller
concept.cypher: MATCH (c:Class)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(t:Type) WHERE t.fqn IN [ 'org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController', 'org.springframework.stereotype.Controller' ] SET c:Controller RETURN count(c) AS MarkedControllers

concept.description: Labels every class annotated with @Service with :Service
concept.cypher: MATCH (c:Class)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(t:Type) WHERE t.fqn = 'org.springframework.stereotype.Service' SET c:Service RETURN count(c) AS MarkedServices

concept.description: Labels every class annotated with @Repository with :Repository
concept.cypher: MATCH (c:Class)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(a:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(t:Type) WHERE t.fqn = 'org.springframework.stereotype.Repository' SET c:Repository RETURN count(c) AS MarkedRepositories

concept.description: Labels classes in packages ending in .api as :ApiLayer
concept.cypher: MATCH (p:Package)-[:CONTAINS]->(c:Class) WHERE p.fqn ENDS WITH '.api' SET c:ApiLayer RETURN count(c) AS MarkedApiClasses

concept.description: Labels classes in packages ending in .domain as :DomainLayer
concept.cypher: MATCH (p:Package)-[:CONTAINS]->(c:Class) WHERE p.fqn ENDS WITH '.domain' SET c:DomainLayer RETURN count(c) AS MarkedDomainClasses

concept.description: Labels classes in packages ending in .infrastructure as :InfrastructureLayer
concept.cypher: MATCH (p:Package)-[:CONTAINS]->(c:Class) WHERE p.fqn ENDS WITH '.infrastructure' SET c:InfrastructureLayer RETURN count(c) AS MarkedInfraClasses

constraint.description: Controllers must not directly depend on Repositories.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (ctrl:Controller)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(repo:Repository) RETURN ctrl.fqn AS Controller, repo.fqn AS Repository

constraint.description: Domain classes must not depend on Infrastructure classes.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (d:DomainLayer)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(i:InfrastructureLayer) RETURN d.fqn AS DomainClass, i.fqn AS InfrastructureClass

constraint.description: API layer classes must not directly depend on Infrastructure classes.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (a:ApiLayer)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(i:InfrastructureLayer) RETURN a.fqn AS ApiClass, i.fqn AS InfrastructureClass

constraint.description: No cyclic package dependencies between top-level application packages.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (p1:Package)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(p2:Package)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(p1) WHERE p1.fqn STARTS WITH 'com.ent.smarttopic' AND p2.fqn STARTS WITH 'com.ent.smarttopic' AND p1 <> p2 RETURN p1.fqn AS Package1, p2.fqn AS Package2
